name: Cloudflare DNS-only alias
summary: Create DNS-only Cloudflare records that alias hostnames to origin edges and ACM validation CNAMEs.
use_when: A product uses Cloudflare DNS in front of an ALB/NLB and must keep proxying off.
proposed_guarantees: Zone and API token remain caller-owned
failure_modes: Proxying enabled and origin SG blocks Cloudflare edges

evidence.basis: Behavioral boundaries informed by repeated DNS-only Cloudflare+ALB patterns in active maintainer products; identifying private paths are not published.
ajent-social production infra documents DNS-only Cloudflare CNAME to the load balancer.
Active-repo census (2026-09-25) maps Cloudflare DNS-only alias as a repeated extract candidate.

alternatives.name: infrastructure.tenant-dns-tls
alternatives.assessment: Use Route53 when the zone is on Route53; use dnsalias when the zone is on Cloudflare.

open_questions: Live Cloudflare apply evidence before promotion.
